name: ai-studio-ghrab
description: Profesionální federované PWA osmi chráněných školních aplikací včetně Lesson Hubu, manuálů, řízeného přístupu a jednotné GHRAB QA brány

scripts.build: npm run generate:changelog && node scripts/verify-ai-core.mjs && node scripts/generate-ai-readiness.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run generate:changelog && npm run format:check && node scripts/verify-ai-core.mjs && node scripts/generate-ai-readiness.mjs && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/verify-ai-core.mjs && node scripts/generate-ai-readiness.mjs && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.test:p2: npm run build && npm run qa:platform
scripts.qa:p3: npm run verify:platform && npm run qa:quality && npm run qa:browser && npm run qa:reflow && npm run qa:axe
scripts.test:p3: npm run build && npm run qa:p3
scripts.qa:p3:ci: npm run verify:platform && npm run qa:quality && npm run qa:reflow && npm run qa:browser && AXE_REQUIRED=1 npm run qa:axe
scripts.qa:p5: npm run qa:lock && npm run build && npm run verify:platform && npm run qa:quality && npm run qa:browser && npm run qa:runtime && npm run qa:xss && node scripts/qa-p5-release.mjs && node scripts/qa-p5-acceptance.mjs
scripts.qa:p5:ci: npm run qa:lock && npm run build && npm run verify:platform && npm run qa:quality && npm run qa:browser && npm run qa:runtime && npm run qa:xss && npm run qa:axe && AXE_REQUIRED=1 node scripts/qa-p5-release.mjs && node scripts/qa-p5-acceptance.mjs
